meta.source: WVU / USDA NRCS CIG Soil Health Demonstration — West Virginia plant-diversity field trial
meta.design: 20 farms x Control (unseeded) / High Diversity / Low Diversity plots; High & Low no-till drill-seeded spring 2022.
meta.metrics: Sown species carry an establishment index combining mean dry-weight biomass 2023-2025 (weight 0.6) and % cover May 2026 (weight 0.4), each as the normalized seeded-vs-Control contrast in [-1,1]. Unsown species carry an absolute abundance index (0-1) used as positive-only evidence that the species suits a location.
meta.caveats: Plant identification was not perfect; the no-till drill seeding method was not controlled as a separate factor. Each species carries an ID-reliability factor that scales its nudge, and sown species that were never detected stay neutral unless they are a genuine (high-confidence) failure. Treat the signal as supporting evidence, not proof. Only species already in the planner are included.
meta.siteMatching: At runtime the planner weights each trial farm by similarity to the user site over pH, clay %, precipitation (MAP) and moisture deficit (CMD), using per-species matchWeights derived from which of those variables best predicts that species establishment. The site-weighted index is then scaled by sample size and ID reliability.
